name: trusted-by-hero
title: Trusted by hero
description: A left-aligned promise with two actions and a ruled strip of customer marks at the foot, so proof is on screen at first load.
docs: Pass title, actions, proofLabel ("Trusted by 4,200 teams"), logos (the Logo shape of LogoCloud: a name, a mark and an optional link) and, optionally, eyebrow, description and a rating with a score, a count and a source. The hero is at least 100svh tall with the strip pinned to its foot, so the proof is on the first screen; pass a min-h class that takes a header's height off when a bar sits above it. From 1280px the label, the six marks and the rating share one line; below that the label and the rating share a line above the marks. Where the marks still do not fit, such as on a phone, they scroll sideways and snap instead of wrapping, the edge with more past it fades out so it is plain there is more, and the strip is a stop for the keyboard only while there is something to scroll. Each mark is named for a screen reader and reaches full strength on hover and focus, and nothing animates.
